summary: Iteration 5: Future-day booking, Driver Day Summary, Printable Label Sheet. Backend: 14/14 new pytest pass + 30/30 regression (44/44). Frontend (375x667 web preview): customer day/slot picker, admin batch-by-day + future route (no DISPATCH, date in subtitle), print-labels (opens labels.html?autoprint=1 tab, no error toast), admin stop-sheet move-off toast + sheet close + resequence, driver summary (in-progress, empty, complete states) all work. Found 3 real bugs: (1) GET /drivers/{id}/route returns a FUTURE planned route over today's planned route; (2) arrive/deliver allowed on stops of a future (not-started) route and driver manifest shows NAVIGATE/OPEN DROP for it; (3) customer tracking screen keeps stale ETA/driver/alert after booking another day. Plus minor validation issue (compact date '20261026' accepted). No deprecated Expo packages detected. Twilio NOT triggered. Data reset at end.

critical.issue: When a driver has both a future planned route and a today planned route, it returns whichever planned route find_one hits first (no service_date filter/sort). Repro: batch SoMa for drv-2 service_date=tomorrow (R-102), then batch Sunset for drv-2 today (R-103) -> /drivers/drv-2/route returns R-102 (tomorrow), so the driver app shows 'SCHEDULED FOR 25 SUN' and no START ROUTE for today's route. Fix: query planned with service_date >= today sorted by service_date asc (server.py:545-546).

No route-status/service_date guard: stops on a future-dated planned route can be arrived/delivered today (verified arrive -> 200 on R-102 tomorrow stop). Once 'arrived', set_window refuses day changes. Driver manifest (driver/[driverId].tsx) also renders next-stop-card with NAVIGATE/OPEN DROP for scheduled future routes. Fix: reject with 400 when route.service_date > today (or route not active), and hide next-stop actions when route-scheduled-notice is shown.

minor.issue: date.fromisoformat on Python 3.11+ accepts compact 'YYYYMMDD'; POST /routes/batch with service_date '20261026' created route R-104 with service_date '20261026', which breaks all string comparisons (today_str compare, zones/eligibility). Validate with regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ and normalise via .isoformat(). Batch/zones also have no upper bound on service_date (only window booking enforces +13).

on_time_rate counts deliveries without a window as on-time (4 delivered, 2 windowed -> 100%). Spec says 'delivered within window end' - consider on_time_rate = windowed_on_time/windowed_delivered, or label clearly. Also summary has no 'date' param on frontend (always today).

integration_issues.flow: Customer books a different day (customer/[code].tsx:61 requestWindow)
integration_issues.issue: After PUT /window, code does setLive({ ...t, stop: st }) which overrides the fresher WS/refetch payload (t = live ?? q.data). Result: booking TMRW for MD1002 (moved off R-101) still shows ETA 15:00, 5 STOPS AWAY, driver Marcus Reid, no 'Scheduled for' banner; booking TODAY back still shows 'SCHEDULED FOR 2026-10-25'. Correct only after reload. Fix: after PUT, fetch /track/{code} (or setLive(null) and await q.refetch()) instead of merging stop into stale payload.

issues: RE-OPTIMIZE button label wraps to 2 lines at 375px when LABELS button is present; header subtitle truncated ('2.7 KM P...')
Alert banner shows raw ISO 'SCHEDULED FOR 2026-10-25' while the rest of the UI uses dayLabel ('25 SUN')
After route completion, reload shows 'NO ROUTE ASSIGNED' (completed routes not returned) rather than route-complete state; empty-view-summary-button still reaches SHIFT COMPLETE summary so acceptable
Day/slot chips are 36px tall (hitSlop 4 makes ~44 effective) - ok; internal 'day' state not resynced when date prop changes from WS

action_items: Fix GET /drivers/{id}/route to prefer today's (earliest service_date >= today) planned route over future ones
Block arrive/deliver/fail (and geofence) for stops on routes with service_date > today / not active; hide NAVIGATE/OPEN DROP on driver manifest for scheduled future routes
customer/[code].tsx requestWindow: replace setLive({...t, stop: st}) with a fresh /track/{code} fetch so ETA/driver/alert update after day change
Strict YYYY-MM-DD validation in check_service_date (reject '20261026'); optionally cap batch/zones date at +13 days
Optional: on_time_rate should be based on windowed deliveries only; format alert date with dayLabel
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1084 lines (>700) - consider splitting routes/summary/labels into modules
simulate-step 'meters' is a query param, not body
admin route print on web uses window.open synchronously in onPress - works (popup opened in test)

success_rate.backend: 100% of planned tests (44/44) - 2 additional bugs found by exploratory API checks
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; customer post-booking state stale)

seed_data_creation: None; used POST /api/admin/reset before and after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server clock is Oct 2026 (LA). Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist loadscope; modules share DB via reset). Admin stop sheet uses slide animation - wait ~1.5s before clicking admin-window-* chips. Summary KPI cards use FadeInDown - wait before reading text. Do not run test_twilio_contact.py (paid).
rca_of_issue: Driver route: find_one({'status':'planned'}) without service_date ordering. Future-route delivery: arrive/deliver only check stop.status. Customer stale UI: local live state merged with PUT response overrides WS payload broadcast earlier in the same request.
